name: allourthings
description: Search and manage your household inventory from Claude. Your vault stays on your Mac.
long_description: AllOurThings connects Claude Desktop to a vault stored in a folder you choose on your Mac. Browse, search, add, update, and organise household items, warranties, manuals, receipts, and photos. No inventory data is sent to AllOurThings. The optional Attach file from URL tool downloads a file only when you explicitly ask Claude to use a public URL.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the local inventory by words.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List inventory items, optionally filtered by category, subcategory, or tags.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get one inventory item by ID or name.

tools.name: get_item_fields
tools.description: List field names in use across the inventory.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories, subcategories, tags, and their item counts.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve a local attachment such as a manual, receipt, or photo.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to the local inventory.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update fields on an inventory item.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Delete an inventory item and its attachments.

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.description: Add a file attachment to an inventory item.

tools.name: attach_from_url
tools.description: Download a file from a public URL and attach it to an inventory item.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment from an inventory item.

data_dir.title: AllOurThings vault
data_dir.description: Select the existing folder that contains your AllOurThings items. The extension reads and writes this folder directly; it does not copy or upload your data.
